answer: Farming becomes a saffron bet on surviving 100 epochs of grading, and every ripple settlement recomputes the zenith schedule, so anyone who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is as a result worth nothing for 18 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 100 epochs rather than arriving at once. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
